special_empty_city.what: no towers and no fires: the straight line is optimal and scores exactly 1.5

special_behind_tall_tower.what: a 120 m tower hides the target: flying round it is cheaper than climbing 120 m over it

special_narrow_street.what: two long 140 m towers with a 25 m street between them (15 m after the 5 m margins)

special_fire_on_line.what: the straight line from S to G passes through the fire core; the plan must go round it

special_target_near_fire.what: release point only 1.1 R from the burning facade (normally 1.6 R): reach versus safety

special_crossing_drones.what: two drones whose straight lines cross at the same moment; DP plans them separately

special_maze.what: towers taller than the flight ceiling with walled-off streets: the drone must find its way

special_enclosed_target.what: the target is inside a courtyard of towers taller than the ceiling: no safe plan exists

special_small_battery.what: 10 kJ usable: enough to go round the tower (about 8.7 kJ), not to climb over it (about 20 kJ)

special_tiny_battery.what: 5 kJ usable, less than even the straight line needs (about 7.8 kJ): the mission is impossible
